items.statement: Signed definitive agreement to acquire Decision Point Private Limited, a CPG analytics and Gen-AI solutions provider, using IPO proceeds earmarked for inorganic growth.
items.quote: we have been able to identify, have conversations, and get aligned with Decision Point, the new s about which has been shared with you all today.

items.statement: Expects CPG business to become second largest vertical after technology and contribute a significant percentage of revenue within a three-year timeframe.
items.quote: We expect that our CPG business will be even stronger and grow faster on the back of this acquisition, and it will contribute a significant percentage of revenue in a three-year timeframe.

items.statement: Decision Point clocked $12.8 million revenue in CY23 with ~30% EBITDA margins and grew US revenue from ~$500K to $3.5M in the last year.
items.quote: In terms of the revenue for CY23, Decision Point clocked close to about $12.8 million in revenue, with EBITDA margins close to about 30%.

items.statement: Decision Point grew at 50%+ CAGR over the last two-plus years up to CY22 and ~20% in the last year.
items.quote: if you look at their CAGR for the last two plus years, they were growing in excess of 50% year on year.

items.statement: Beagle Gen-AI product currently contributes 5-7% of Decision Point revenue; expected to reach 10-15% over two years.
items.quote: Beagle as a product is only about 5% to 7% of their revenues and the rest of it is all services revenue. But we are expecting that the Beagle product revenue will grow much faster in the coming years, and we are expecting that it could potentially reach somewhere between 10% to 15% over a two-year period.

items.statement: Decision Point serves large Fortune 500/100 CPG leaders with no client overlap with LatentView except possibly one client.
items.quote: Decision Point has been working with large Fortune 500 companies. In fact, many of them are leaders in their space. We are not at liberty to share the names of the clients at this point in time.

items.statement: Deal consideration includes retention bonuses for key personnel and earnouts tied to Decision Point and combined CPG practice performance.
items.quote: Part of the consideration of this deal is also in relation to retention bonuses that will be paid to key personnel. So, we are putting in all of these mechanisms in place to make sure that one, we are able to operate as one combined team, and secondly, everybody is aligned on the same goals and targets.

items.statement: Decision Point CEO Ravi Shankar to lead combined CPG practice; LatentView delivery head to manage combined CPG delivery; integration effective day one.
items.quote: Ravi Shankar, who is the founder and CEO of Decision Point, will come on board and he will become the overall lead for the combined CPG practice. And this is going to take effect immediately.

items.statement: Decision Point offshore gross margins comparable to LatentView at 60%+; 30% EBITDA margin driven by high gross margin and tight opex, not low opex alone.
items.quote: If you were to look at the margins, just for the offshore business on a standalone basis without including the onsite business, we have very comparable margins, which are in excess of 60% plus.

items.statement: Expect closing formalities in 30-60 days (mid-Q1); consolidated financials visible from Q2 onwards.
items.quote: We expect that this process could take anywhere between 30 to 60 days. Based on the list of activities that need to get completed. So, our expectation at this point in time is somewhere in the middle of Q1, we will be able to complete all the closing formalities. And end of Q1, you may not get a full quarter view of the current. But Q2 onwards, you'll be able to see financial results for LatentVie

items.statement: Acquisition adds consulting-heavy Revenue Growth Management (RGM) capabilities in pricing, promotion, and assortment analytics for CPG clients.
items.quote: If you look at the nature of the work, the Decision Point has been doing in the area of RGM, a lot of it is fairly consulting oriented just in terms of the fuzziness of the problem that you need to go after.

items.statement: Beagle Gen-AI product already generates ~$1M revenue; LatentView Gen-AI revenue to increase with addition of Beagle and new use-case wins (e.g., European bank analyst reports).
items.quote: Beagle already generates about a million dollars of revenue. So, with the addition of Beagle, our own Gen-AI quantum of revenue will go up.

items.statement: Decision Point delivery team 95% India-based (vs LatentView 20% US onsite); enables lower revenue per employee but comparable offshore gross margins.
items.quote: But in the case of Decision Point, almost entirely, their entire workforce sits out of India. They have a few folks in LATAM and maybe a handful of people in the US who are in delivery roles. But 95% of their entire delivery team sits out of India.

items.statement: Decision Point has presence in Latin America, growing US and Europe footprint; LatentView go-to-market investments in US/Europe to accelerate Decision Point solutions.
items.quote: Decision Point already has a presence in Latin America in addition to a g rowing presence in the US and Europe. The investments that we have made in recent times on the go to market side in the US and Europe are going to be a fairly important aspect of how we'll be able to take the solutions from Decision Point around revenue growth management, as well as conversational analytics into those market

items.statement: Integration execution and synergy realization remain key risks; cultural alignment assessed as strong during due diligence.
items.quote: Of course, the hard work of getting the integration plan executed and many of the synergies being realized still remains ahead of us. But based on all of the interactions so far and the commitment, passion, interest displayed by both sides, I am very happy with the progress that we have made.

items.statement: Expects 15% volume growth for FY25
items.quote: Volume growth as there is no inflation the volume growth what we are expecting is somewhere around 15% we can expect.

items.statement: Expects 15% topline growth and 1-1.5% bottom-line increase for FY25
items.quote: The topline growth of 15% and on the bottom-line one to one and half percent increase is possible

items.statement: Expects margin improvement of around 150 basis points
items.quote: We can expect 150 basis points we can expect but uh actually the base is now set actually the capacity utilization is also brighter in all divisions

items.statement: Ice-cream and curd demand expected to be strong in summer season starting April 7
items.quote: This year probably the temperature is also likely to be hotter and better and last year probably the school holidays and other things also flashed and the holidays are just balancing out after covid now the holidays are starting by April 7 the season should be much better in my opinion

items.statement: Ice-cream likely to grow much faster in summer; curd division also expected to do better
items.quote: In fact probably ice -cream is likely to grow much faster in the summer season and also not only ice -cream probably we also have our curd division which is likely to do better in the summer

items.statement: Raw material prices now under control with enough stock to manage season
items.quote: Because actually we have got enough stock of material to just go through the season and last year before we had the raw material prices out of control and now everything is under control and we have got enough stocks to manage.

items.statement: Debt expected to reduce to 1200-1300 crores by June quarter end
items.quote: Maybe 1300 - 1200 is possible 1300 okay it comes down by so that'll be nearly 300 to 400 crores lower in comparison to the number that we last have

items.statement: Expects debt to come down to around 500 crores by June 2025
items.quote: Around 2025 June you can expect the debt to come down to five hundreds.

items.statement: Heavy investment in extruded technology and Hyderabad plant gives unique product advantage and premium pricing
items.quote: we have made heavy investments on extruded technology and the latest plant of ours in Hyderabad is able to churn out and we are also able to get a premium out of it

items.statement: Acquired Dextara Digital for $17.3M upfront plus $3M deferred and up to $3.7M earnout over two years
items.value: 17.3 million USD upfront, 3 million USD deferred, up to 3.7 million USD earnout
items.quote: We will pay a total of $17.3 million, out of which $14.3 will be upfront and $3 million will be over a period of two years. In addition to this, we will pay up to $3.7 million on achievement of certain business targets in the next two years.

items.statement: Expect 10% revenue growth and 90 bps EBIT margin accretion in digital technologies from acquisition
items.quote: With this acquisition, our EBIT in digital technologies sales should grow by about 90 basis points, which is 0.9% of the EBIT with technologies business currently. In terms of revenue, this acquisition will help getting another 10% revenue growth in the coming year

items.statement: Dextara has 16.5% EBIT margin and ~19% EBITDA margin, accretive to Datamatics
items.quote: Dextara was founded in 2019 and within a span of four years, they have grown to a revenue of $7.2 million, with healthy EBIT margin of almost at 16.5%. This margin will be EBIT accretive to Datamatics.

items.statement: Salesforce market growing 20-25% annually, estimated $50B by 2026
items.quote: Salesforce business is growing business and growing 20%, 25% worldwide in the last three years, market is huge. So, it is estimated to be 50 billion by 2026.

items.statement: Dextara 85% revenue from US/UK, 15% Asia; 25-30% of Datamatics' 300+ customers use Salesforce
items.quote: On the revenue customer profile, approximately 85% of their revenue is coming from Western markets, within U.S. and U.K., and 15% will be from Asian market, primarily India.

items.statement: Dextara brings CPQ, DXHealth+, DXTemplates products plus Health/Service/Sales cloud expertise
items.quote: The company has developed products such as Dextara CPQ, DXHealth+ and DXTemplates and these align with Datamatics strategy of continued differentiation and growing in a more linear fashion.

items.statement: Retaining entire Dextara team including founders who scaled $1.2B operations at Virtusa
items.quote: So yes, we will retain the entire management team. When we buy services compan y, what we really have is a core team of people, and people are very critical. So yes, the agenda is to retain

items.statement: Acquisition funded entirely from internal accruals and resources
items.quote: All these things will be from internal accruals and internal resources.

items.statement: Dextara achieved Summit partnership with Salesforce in 4 years with $7.2M revenue
items.quote: Dextara has been growing very rapidly and in the short span of 4 years, they have achieved the highest level of Summit partnership with Salesforce.

items.statement: Summit partnership improves Salesforce visibility and deal access for combined entity
items.quote: Now this will also help us because the moment we engage, our engagement with Salesforce will go up several notches becau se we will be at that level of

items.statement: All-cash deal chosen because management believes Datamatics stock is undervalued
items.quote: So, we still believe that Datamatics is not fairly valued in the market. So, if we did a swap, we believe we'll be selling cheap.

items.statement: Dextara operations in US (20 people) and Hyderabad; will merge into single Salesforce practice led by Dextara team
items.quote: They have about 20 -odd people physically in the U.S., which are very good people, and that's really helps in engaging with the American customers. So we have local expertise in America as well as in India.

items.statement: Targets better-than-industry revenue growth; industry expected to grow 10-11%
items.quote: And based on our internal efforts and estimations, we are targeting better growth than the industry.

items.statement: EBITDA margin expected in a range of plus or minus 2% around current levels
items.quote: No, so margin plus minus 2% will be the range of our reporting.

items.statement: Q3 FY24 EBITDA margin fell to 10% from 16% YoY due to higher retailer margin, overheads, and raw material mix
items.quote: If you compare the same numbers in Q3 of FY23 we witnessed a revenue drop of 1% and EBITDA margin lower from 16% to 10%.

items.statement: 9M FY24 EBITDA margin declined to 12% from 14% YoY; gross margin stable at 29%
items.quote: Compared to 9 months of previous year there was a drop in revenue by 2% and EBITDA margin dropped from 14% to 12%.

items.statement: Increased retailer margin on INR5 SKUs from 50 paise to 75 paise in Q2 FY24, impacting EBITDA by ~INR13 cr in Q3
items.quote: In Q2 of FY24 we had increased the retailer margin on our INR5 SKUs on Namkeen and Gathiya products from INR 50 paisa to INR 75 paisa. This has impacted our EBITDA to close to INR13 crores for the quarter 3 of FY24.

items.statement: Palm oil prices down 23% YoY in Q3; chana prices up 24% YoY; net raw material benefit ~INR9.5 cr passed via grammage increase
items.quote: Overall there has been a reduction of 9.47 crores in our raw material prices in Q3 of FY24 versus Q3 of previous year. And we have passed on this benefit to our customers.

items.statement: Chana prices rose 11% and urad 14% QoQ in Q3 FY24, pressuring gross margin
items.quote: In Q3 of FY'24 when we compare it with Q2 of FY'24, we have witnessed Chana prices have increased by 11% and Urad price has increased by 14% versus Q2, which has been one of the major factor affecting gross profit margin of the company in Q3 of FY'24.

items.statement: INR5 SKU share fell to 69% of revenue in Q3 FY24 from 75% YoY; INR10 SKU grew ~43% YoY
items.quote: INR5 SKU contributes 69% of our revenue which was 75% in Q3 of last year. We have witnessed a growth in INR10 SKU at least by 43% in Q3 of FY'24 versus Q3 of FY'23

items.statement: Wafers volume grew ~35% YoY in Q3 and ~28% in 9M FY24; western snacks now 31% of revenue
items.quote: So there has been a growth in number of pouches we have sold in Q3 FY'24 versus Q3 FY'23 of approximately 35% and in nine months we have witnessed a growth in number of pouches to the extent of 28%.

items.statement: Q4 demand expected similar to Q3 but better than last year's Q4; industry sees Feb-March as peak season
items.quote: Q4 will be similar but much better than last year Q4. Overall, if you look at the industry, I think Q4 normally in the snack industry is the oxygen market particularly in the month of Feb and March.

items.statement: Focus states (Maharashtra, MP, Rajasthan, UP) revenue grew 13% YoY in Q3 and 9% in 9M; now 24% of total revenue
items.quote: We witnessed a growth of 13% in revenue year on year from focus state in Q3 and 9% for 9 months from previous year.

items.statement: Core state Gujarat contribution fell to 75% in Q3 from 80% YoY; 20-25% retail whitespace identified
items.quote: Our revenue contribution from core state in Q3 of FY24 was at 75% as against 80% of Q3 of previous year.

items.statement: Overall capacity utilization below 40%; can double revenue without major capex; next major capex in 2-3 years
items.quote: Our capacity utilization from all the plants put together is below 40% and we have already invested in future capex and there is a potential to grow revenue by 2x without any major capex.

items.statement: Minor capex for backward integration (e.g., besan unit in Nagpur); no major plant capex needed for 2-3 years
items.quote: Minor capex here and there definitely it will be required but not the major one. So, basically we require any capex for backward integration, not for the manufacturing of our plant.

items.statement: Debt reduced from INR107 cr (Mar'23) to INR26 cr (Sep'23); repaid ~INR75 cr in H1 FY24
items.quote: We believe in financial discipline and the company has judicially utilized cash towards lowering debt from INR 107 crores in March '23 to INR 26 crores as of September '23 and generated cash flow from operation of INR122 crores in FY'23 which allow us to reinvest this in new market and products. So overall, we have repaid close to INR75 crores of our borrowing in six months of the operation in FY'

items.statement: Inventory days average 45-60 days; driven by seasonal procurement of potato and chana in Q4
items.quote: So normal average inventory period will be in the range of 45 to 60 days.

items.statement: Exports <1% of revenue; plan to build export team and focus in coming years
items.quote: As of now, we have exports around one percent, less than one percent of our contribution.

items.statement: Hired senior sales professionals (RSM, ASM, National Sales Head) in FY24; cost incurred now, benefit in coming years
items.quote: So during FY24, we have built our sales team. We have hired a sales professional from FMCG companies, which includes RSM, ASM, National Sales Head, where the cost has come in FY24. Benefit of the cost what we have incurred will definitely be there in coming years.

items.statement: Retail touchpoints ~5 lakh as of Dec'23; 3 lakh+ in Gujarat with 15-20% whitespace
items.quote: So, total retail outlet reach has been close to 5 lakhs as of December closing.

items.statement: Family split in FY23 caused distributor and employee attrition; recovery underway with distributors returning
items.quote: In a year back, we had this family split, where the Bipin Bhai promoter acquired the stake of his brother. And for that reason, we did the IP O also for repayment of loss. Because of the family split, and there was some internal disturbance, and we had higher attrition in terms of our employees. And even the distributors has left us because the brother who moved from us has also started the simila

items.statement: Engaged creative agency Scarecrow to transition from regional to national brand
items.quote: We have also appointed an agency, Scarecrow, who's a creative agency, national level agency. They will help us in designing our company's strategy in terms of communications to customers and wide market. So we are also focusing on making our regional brand a national brand by branding, etcetera.

items.statement: MD & CEO Chandra Shekhar Ghosh will retire on July 9, 2024, after completing his current term
items.quote: I have decided to retire from my position as Managing Director & CEO when my current term ends on July 9th, 2024.

items.statement: Ghosh will transition to a strategic role at the holding company level, not a board role at the bank
items.quote: I am transitioning to a higher strategic role at the holding company level. In my new role, I will pursue a strategic responsibility where I can leverage my experience and insights to contribute to the group's overall growth and prosperity.

items.statement: Board and selection committee will identify and appoint successor under the Succession Plan
items.quote: It also gives the Board & the selection committee time to identify and appoint my successor under the Succession Plan that the Bank has in place.

items.statement: If successor not identified within three months, an internal interim CEO will take over until final appointment
items.quote: We are planning that if within three months we do not identify a successor, in the interim period, someone internally will take the role of interim CEO until that final one will be happen.

items.statement: Selection of candidates will take minimum three months based on prior experience, then goes to RBI for approval
items.quote: Whatever, our experience in the earlier selections, when we selected two executive directors on the basis of that experience we need a minimum three months of time for selection of candidates and then it will to go to RBI and then whatever is the time taken by RBI for approval

items.statement: Board will independently assess requirements and select successor fit for future growth, considering both internal and external candidates
items.quote: I feel that I will leave that decision to the board. They will independently assess requirements and the best way they would like to select the successor, who is fit for this type of bank for future growth and achieve strategic objectives.

items.statement: Senior management team including two Executive Directors, CFO, and Head of Mortgages & Retail Assets is in place to lead next growth phase
items.quote: As you are aware, in the recent past, we have enhanced the Bank's leadership with our two Executive Directors (Ratan Kumar Kesh and Rajinder Kumar Babbar), CFO – Rajeev Mantri, Head of Mortgages and Retail Assets – Santosh Nair, who are working closely with other senior leaders in the Bank.

items.statement: Ghosh holds ~0.5% stake in bank as MD; family holding at holdco level is less than 2%
items.quote: As an MD, I have a stake in the bank. It is so because I was a Founder. I have some initial capital that I needed to give to the bank to start it. That is only half percent. But the holding company level, we have the holding at the family level, the stake is less than two percent.

items.statement: No communication received from RBI regarding retirement announcement
items.quote: No, no communication from RBI.

items.statement: Retirement decision has no linkage to ongoing audit; audit to conclude in about one month
items.quote: the audit is still going on and it is going to take another one month or so to get concluded. We haven't heard anything from the auditor or from NCGTC in this regard. Therefore, it has absolutely no linkage with the audit.

items.statement: CBS transformation completed in October 2023; stabilization period influenced retirement timing
items.quote: if you recall, we have seen the biggest transformation of IT, which is the CBS. And I needed to stabilize it.

items.statement: Business momentum has returned with good asset and liability growth and improvement in portfolio quality as of March 31, 2024
items.quote: I am also seeing that business momentum has come back with good assets and liabilities growth, and improvement in portfolio quality. You would have seen our initial disclosure numbers as of 31 March 2024 in this regard.

items.statement: Strategic plan prepared with senior team in March; details to be shared with Q4 results
items.quote: I have planned with my senior team a good strategic plan, which is possible to execute. My team and myself have engaged on this plan in March and I hope a realistic strategic plan has been prepared.

items.statement: Revenue grew 13.8% YoY to INR 21,724 million in 9M FY24 from INR 19,083 million in 9M FY23
items.quote: Our revenue grew by 13.8% to reach INR 21,724 million from INR 19,083 million in the corresponding period of the previous fiscal.

items.statement: EBITDA grew 46.2% YoY to INR 5,208 million in 9M FY24; EBITDA margin expanded 495 bps to 23.3%
items.quote: EBITDA was up by 46.2% YoY was at INR 5,208 million as compared to INR 3,563 million in the 9M FY23. Our EBITDA margin expanded by 495 basis points to 23.3% in the 9M FY24 which stood at 18.4% in the 9M FY23.

items.statement: PAT grew 60.7% YoY to INR 3,262 million in 9M FY24; PAT margin expanded 438 bps to 14.6%
items.quote: Our PAT recorded a robust growth of 60.7% reaching INR 3,262 million in the 9M FY24 as against INR 2,030 million in the 9M FY23. Our PAT margin stood at 14.6% as against 10.5% in the 9 M FY23 an expansion of 438 basis points

items.statement: Generated positive cash from operations of INR 3,992 million as of end FY23
items.quote: The company is generating positive cash from operations to a tune of INR3,992 million as at the end of FY23.

items.statement: Current average capacity utilization across invested businesses is 75%+
items.quote: We continue to work with a very, tight way of managing our capacity utilization. So we are seeing, on an average, it is all 75-plus kind of a situation that we see in the businesses that we have invested so far.

items.statement: Domestic OEM business continues to outgrow market through new market penetration, new customers, and supporting existing customer programs
items.quote: So, basically, Matta Ji, that we continue to , as I said, even the domestic business, we are continuing to outgrow the market. And this comes from various possibilities of penetrations into markets which we have not penetrated earlier, getting into new customers, and also trying to ensure that we completely support our existing customers on all their new

items.statement: No single segment (2W, 3W, PV) exceeds 17-18% of overall business; revenue mix diversified across segments
items.quote: I can tell you for sure that no one segment of the market, whether it is two-wheeler, whether it is three-wheeler, or whether it is passenger car, is over maybe 17%, 18% of our overall business.

items.statement: Exports contribute 19% of standalone revenue in FY23; presence in 45+ countries across 5 continents with global OEMs like VW, JLR, BMW, Honda
items.quote: Regarding our export activities which contribute 19% of the stand alone revenue in FY23, we hold a leading position as exporters of our products with a presence in over 45 countries spanning five continents.

items.statement: Leadership team includes professionals with 30+ years tenure; robust succession pipeline and talent nurturing system in place
items.quote: Anchored by a robust leadership team, we benefit from seasoned professionals, some of whom have been with us for over 30 years, fostering a deep-rooted commitment to our mission and values. We have implemented a meticulous system to identify and nurture the top talent, ensuring a continuous influx of skilled individuals who align with our vision. Moreover, our investment in cultivating a strong le

items.statement: Achieved 20% reduction in Scope II emissions, 20% increase in renewable energy mix (solar/wind), 30% increase in recycled material usage
items.quote: We have achieved several milestones in our ESG journey, like three of our plans having the status of zero liquid discharge and state-of-the-art ETP and STP. Further, we have achieved a 20% reduction in scope II emissions, a 20% increase in the mix of renewable energy, solar power and wind power, and a 30% increase in the use of recycled material.

items.statement: Margin expansion driven by capacity utilization improvement, sustainable power solutions, operational efficiencies, productivity gains, and cost bleeders reduction
items.quote: Basically, we have , as I said, we have been working on a number of areas, and it included improving o n our capacity utilization, ensuring that we are able to work on multiple multimodal systems of power supplies in terms of using also the sustainable solutions, bringing in a lot of operational efficiencies and improving productivities, and also looking at our bleeders and ensuring that we are co

items.statement: Highest ever order inflow of Rs 2,050 crore in FY24 including 11% export orders
items.quote: The Company received the highest ever order inflow during the year of Rs.2,050 crore including the export orders of 11%.

items.statement: Unexecuted order book of Rs 2,582 crore as on 31 March 2024, 72% growth vs FY23, to be executed over ~15 months
items.quote: The unexecuted order book (UOB) as on 31 March 2024 totals to Rs. 2,582 crores; 72% growth v/s FY23 to be executed over the execution cycle of approximately 15 months.

items.statement: Total inquiries under negotiation of Rs 17,000+ crore across all segments including overseas
items.quote: As on 31 March 2024, company has total inquiries of ₹17,000+ crore under negotiation at various stages including overseas inquiries.

items.statement: Expect order inflow of Rs 1,500-2,000 crore based on 15-20% conversion of inquiry pipeline
items.quote: So, if INR17,000 crores of orders are in the pipeline, then anywhere between Rs.1,500 crores to Rs.2,000 crores should not be far-fetched.

items.statement: Target export revenue share of 25% by FY26-27, up from 11% in FY24
items.quote: we have been given a guidance that by FY26 we want 25% share in the export.

items.statement: New plant expansion for green hydrogen and solar transformers started, expected ready by December 2024
items.quote: this plant expansion has already started, and we expect this plant to be ready by December 2024.

items.statement: Current capacity utilization at 60-65%, peak utilization target 85%
items.quote: we are right now operating at around 60% to 65% levels.

items.statement: Plan to be fully backward integrated by December 2025
items.quote: We should be fully backward integrated by December 2025.

items.statement: Q4FY24 EBITDA margin at 12.9%, up 576 bps YoY; FY24 EBITDA margin at 10%, up 155 bps YoY
items.quote: EBIDTA margin was at 12.9%, a sharp 576-bps increase from 7.2% in Q4FY23.

items.statement: Raw material cost at 72-74% of revenue, expected to remain at same levels
items.quote: Our present raw material is around 72% to 74%. You can take it up from the books. Right now, it's going to remain the same levels.

items.statement: Average monthly collection of Rs 144 crore in H2FY24; working capital cycle improving drastically
items.quote: Average monthly collection from customers during H2FY24 was Rs.144 crore which indicates stringent internal controls systems in place.

items.statement: Short-term and long-term borrowings reduced drastically; aiming to reduce borrowings further
items.quote: Even if you see the short-term borrowings, my short-term borrowings has gone down drastically, as well as my long-term borrowings have gone down drastically.

items.statement: Board approved QIP/preferential issue of Rs 500 crore for inorganic growth, capacity expansion, backward integration and working capital reduction; target completion by end of Q1FY25
items.quote: by end of first quarter it should be completed.

items.statement: Deliberately reduced exposure to State Electricity Boards from 51% to 31% of revenue, focusing on EPC contractors for better cash flows
items.quote: We have deliberately taken a decision that we would be quoting less to State Electricity Board and more to EPC contractors who are in eventual ly servicing the State Electricity Board

items.statement: Indian transformer market growing at ~14% CAGR per market research
items.quote: Indian transformer market is increasing by around 14% CAGR levels.

items.statement: Majority of orders have price variation clause, providing protection against input cost fluctuations
items.quote: Basically, the majority of the orders are on the price variable clause.

items.statement: Export revenue grew 117% YoY to Rs 139 crore in FY24, contributing 11% of revenue; export inquiries not exceeding 15% of pipeline
items.quote: For FY24, export revenue was at ₹ 139 crore, a 117% increase from ₹ 64 crore from FY23. Export contribution as a % of revenue was at 11%.

items.statement: Strong demand across renewables, steel, green hydrogen, data centers, railways (Scott/V-connected transformers) and metro projects
items.quote: the main focus is renewables, everywhere. And renewable is the growth driver now.

items.statement: Reduced production cycle time from 55 days to 40 days, targeting further reduction to 32-35 days
items.quote: we have successfully reduced the cycle time down from 55 days to 40 days So, now we are further trying to reduce it down to 32 days, or 35 days.

items.statement: Skilled manpower availability is key constraint for high-voltage transformer capacity expansion
items.quote: You can get money, but where do you get the skilled manpower? That's the main thing.

items.statement: RDSO approved for railway transformers; Scott/V-connected transformers short-circuit testing by end of May 2024
items.quote: We are RDSO approved. The Scott-connected and V-connected transformers, we are getting short-circuit tested by end of May.

items.statement: Successfully tested Dynamic Short Circuit test on 150+ transformers over two decades; 765 kV shunt reactor technology fully absorbed
items.quote: successfully tested the most stringent Dynamic Short Circuit test on multiple transformers of various voltage ratings. With this company has crossed a commendable milestone of successful Dynamic short circuit testing on a record 150 plus transformers in last two decades.

items.statement: Majority of GETCO outstanding received, remaining collections on track
items.quote: we have received majority of the outstanding from the GETCO and the rest of the money is coming as expected.

items.statement: Target revenue of ~Rs 2,100 crore for FY25 based on current order book execution
items.quote: We will try to achieve, if possible.

items.statement: Q4 TCV at record $13.2 billion; FY24 TCV at $42.7 billion, up 25.2% YoY
items.quote: Moving on to our deal wins, TCV in Q4 was at a record high, at $13.2 billion. This includes one mega deal we announced during the quarter.

items.statement: FY24 TCV was $42.7 billion, a record growth of 25.2% YoY
items.quote: Our FY24 TCV was $42.7 billion, a record growth of 25.2% YoY.

items.statement: Large Financial Services client rescoping impacted 15% of work but 85% continues
items.quote: When you re-scope, 15% of the work does not mean that 15% of the revenue goes away in one quarter. It depends on how much of work you had done, how much of the impact you are therefore taking.

items.statement: Differentiated AI approach (Topaz) helping gain mind and market share
items.quote: In addition, our differentiated approach to AI is hel ping us gain mind and market share. Topaz is resonating well with the clients

items.statement: Net debt to EBITDA target kept below 1x; currently at 0.65x
items.quote: And clearly, we have talked about keeping net debt to EBIDTA below 1x and at these levels it will be about 0.65.

items.statement: FY24 capex Rs 1,32,000 crore, down Rs 10,000 crore YoY and below cash profits of Rs 1,42,000 crore
items.quote: And you can also note that the capex for the year is ₹ 1,32,000 crore which is about, you know, last time it was ₹ 1,42,000 crore. So, there has been a ₹ 10,000 crore reduction in capex.

items.statement: Consolidated EBITDA Rs 1,79,000 crore up 16% YoY; consumer EBITDA near Rs 80,000 crore up 17%
items.quote: Looking at FY 2023-24, our EBITDA is at ₹ 1,79,000 crore up 16% YoY. We delivered a net profit of ₹ 79,000 crore, up 7.3% YoY.

items.statement: Retail EBITDA margin 8.1% for FY24, up 50 bps YoY; Q4 margin 8.3% up 60 bps
items.quote: For the full year, the EBITDA from operations was at 8.1%, which is a 50-basis points Y-o-Y growth. For the quarter, it was 8.3%, which is a 60-basis point year -on-year growth.

items.statement: Jio connectivity EBITDA margin 53% in Q4; full year RJIL EBITDA margin up ~100 bps
items.quote: And the EBITDA went up to Rs 13,734 crores, which is growth by 11.5% year-on-year with some operating leverage. So, EBITDA margin at 53%.

items.statement: India oil demand grew 4.6% YoY; ATF 12%, diesel 4.5%, gasoline 6.5%
items.quote: And I'm just focusing on the lower part of the box, which is the year -on-year you can see that overall demand for oil at 4.6% strong growth and if you look at the components, you can see that ATF has bee n close to 12% growth, diesel about 4.5% growth, gasoline about 6.5% growth.

items.statement: Polymer demand up 14% YoY; PE 20%, PP 9%, PVC 9%
items.quote: On the polymer side again looking at the lower part of the box. This is what I was referring to year-on-year growth in Polymer up 14% of which PE has been very strong 20% PP and PVC also have been about 9%.

items.statement: Retail added 1,840 stores in FY24 (15.6 mn sq ft); total area ~80 mn sq ft
items.quote: During the year, we added 1,840 new stores with a gross area addition of 15.6 million. Just for reference, this is more than the total retail area for the next largest retailer in the country.

items.statement: Jio True5G subscribers 108 million; 5G traffic ~30% of mobility data
items.quote: As on date, more than 100 million, in fact 108 million subscribers have migrated to Jio's True 5G services. And if you look at the total traffic that is now being carried, or being contributed, by these 5G subscribers on a 5G network, it is now approaching 30% of the mobility data traffic.

items.statement: Retail registered customers 300 million+; footfalls and transactions over 1 billion
items.quote: Our registered customer base grew upwards of 300 million. Both footfalls and transactions were over a billion for the financial year.

items.statement: Jio subscriber base 481.8 million; net add 10.9 million in Q4
items.quote: Today, the subscriber base stands at 481.8 million as on March 2024, and our ARPU across such a large base is now at Rs 181 or nearly Rs 182 per subscriber.

items.statement: Jio ARPU Rs 181.7 in Q4; 5G services offered free (promotional), 30% of data traffic unmonetized
items.quote: The ARPU was Rs. 181.7 for this quarter, given this quarter had a lesser day plus, I would like to point out here that at this point the 5G services are being offered on a promotional basis.

items.statement: O2C fuel cracks fell 20-45% from elevated levels; petrochemical deltas down 8-21%
items.quote: I talked about the margin environment remaining challenging, and you have seen that in fuel cracks which fell anywhere between 20% and 45%. Of course, they were from elevated levels to some extent offset by lower SAED.

items.statement: O2C benefited from light feed cracking (two-thirds of cracking on light feed) and ethane price advantage vs naphtha
items.quote: We were able to offset that by focusing on light feed cracking economics, which has given that almost two-thirds of our cracking happens on light feed, which is an advantage for us, given where the prices of ethane eased versus naphtha.

items.statement: Retail grocery grew 31%, fashion & lifestyle 23%, consumer electronics 18% YoY
items.quote: In terms of segmental growth, the growth for grocery for FY'24 was the highest at about 31%. Fashion lifestyle grew by about 23% and consumer electronics grew by about 18%.

items.statement: Retail own fashion brands driving growth; three brands crossed Rs 2,000 crore annual sales
items.quote: Our own brands in the fashion lifestyle business, the bulk of what we sell are our own brands, and they continue to drive growth. Three of our brands crossed the milestone of Rs 2,000 crore annual sales.

items.statement: Jio per capita monthly data consumption 28.7 GB (up 35% YoY); total quarterly traffic 40.9 billion GB
items.quote: The total data consumption went up to 40.9 billion GBs for the quarter. So that's, you know, if you look at the previous, the same time last year, that's 35% higher. And the per capita data consumption at 28.7 GB per user per month.

items.statement: KG-D6 production up 57% YoY; current output ~30 mscm gas and 23,000 barrels condensate/day
items.quote: The fields have ramped up, performing as per expectations, producing around 30,000 standard cubic meters at the current juncture , and about 23,000 barrels of condensate.

items.statement: E&P EBITDA Rs 20,191 crore, up 49% YoY; highest ever
items.quote: Oil and gas , the story … ₹ 20,191 crore , this will be the highest EBITDA that we have recorded. This is up about 49%, this is on the back of KG D6 production which itself was up to 57%.

items.statement: Net debt reduced Rs 10,000 crore to Rs 1,16,000 crore; net debt/EBITDA 0.65x
items.quote: And on the balance sheet side, you can see that net debt is lowered down by ₹ 10,000 crore. It was ₹ 1,26,000 crore in March 2023 and now down to ₹ 1,16,000 crore.

items.statement: Retail equity fundraise Rs 17,814 crore completed (QIA, KKR, ADIA, RIL)
items.quote: We completed an equity fundraise of Rs 17,800 crores last year. We had earlier announced fundraise from QIA, KKR , and ADIA and as part of the same round, Reliance Industries infused Rs 2,500 crores, taking the total equity capital raise to about Rs 17,814 crores.

items.statement: Government approved incremental development plan for KG-D6 with potential 4-5 mscm/day additional production
items.quote: One good aspect of this quarter gone by was that we had an incremental development plan approved by the government, which has the potential to deliver incremental production of 4 to 5 million standard cubic meters in the coming few years.

items.statement: O2C risks: OPEC+ cuts, Middle East geopolitics, Russia-Ukraine, energy infrastructure attacks, new refinery supply outpacing demand
items.quote: Overall, when you think of it challenges from a volatility standpoint really is the whole OPEC+ members extending voluntary production cuts, geopolitical tensions in Middle East and the whole Russian - Ukraine aspect and its impact on oil prices.

name: ICICI Lombard General Insurance Company Ltd

items.statement: Industry GDPI growth expected at 13-15% in FY2025; company aims to grow at least in line with industry
items.quote: we do believe industry should continue this journey on growing between 13% to 15% in the coming year. If that happens as the place where we stand, we should at least try to keep pace and grow at least in line with the industry.

items.statement: Target combined ratio around 102% by end of FY2025
items.quote: we would obviously explore opportunities in terms of how we could look at bringing that down to 102% combined by the end of FY2025.

items.statement: Expense of management at 29% of gross premium in FY2024, within 30% regulatory limit
items.quote: For us the overall expense of management as a percentage of the gross premium return stands at about 29%.

items.statement: Industry GDPI grew 12.8% in FY2024; excluding crop and mass health grew 14.8%
items.quote: the General Insurance industry delivered a year-on-year Gross Direct Premium Income (GDPI) growth of 12.8% for FY2024. Excluding crop and mass health growth stood at 14.8%.

items.statement: Company GDPI grew 17.8% in FY2024 to Rs 247.76bn, outpacing industry; Q4 grew 22% to Rs 60.73bn
items.quote: Gross Direct Premium Income (GDPI) of the Company stood at ₹ 247.76 billion in FY2024 compared to ₹ 210.25 billion in FY2023 a growth of 17.8% which was higher than the industry growth of 12.8%.

items.statement: Motor mix FY2024: Private car 51.4%, Two-wheeler 26.8%, Commercial vehicle 21.9%
items.quote: For FY2024, our mix of Private car, Two-wheeler and Commercial vehicle stands at 51.4%, 26.8% and 21.9% respectively.

items.statement: Health segment grew 29% in Q4 and FY2024; Group Health EE grew 31.7% in Q4, 30.3% FY2024; Retail Health grew 21.8% Q4, 20% FY2024
items.quote: The Health segment continued to be the fastest growing segment for the industry. We grew faster than the industry both in Q4 and FY2024, registering a growth of 29% for the quarter and full year.

items.statement: Added over 80 bancassurance partnerships in FY2024
items.quote: During the year, we added over 80 banca partnerships.

items.statement: Strategic tie-up with Policy Bazaar announced; too early to quantify traction, will assess by Q3/Q4 FY2025
items.quote: we probably would be in a better position to reply this in quarter 3 or Quarter 4 as to what traction can come out of it. At this point of time it's just too early, too hard a guess for us as an entity as to where we will be and where we are.

items.statement: Project Orion transformation underway: reimagining processes, modernizing technology, enhancing stakeholder experience
items.quote: Project Orion would entail three pivotal pillars of reimagining processes with a digital-first approach, modernizing technology by shifting away f rom legacy systems and enhancing stakeholder experience through superior engagement models.

items.statement: IRDAI de-notified all tariffs from Dec 2006; insurers can now design products per own underwriting policy; Motor TP pricing remains under tariff
items.quote: De-notification of all tariffs notified by the erstwhile Tariff Advisory Committee which continued to be in force since December 2006. With the de-notification of the existing tariffs, the Company is at liberty to design all the general insurance products in line with its own underwriting policy.

items.statement: No Motor TP rate hike announced for FY2025 yet; company watchful of industry response
items.quote: As you may be aware, no Motor TP rate hike has been announced for FY2025 as yet. We will be watchful of how the industry responds to this in coming days.

items.statement: Strengthened leadership with Anand Singhi as Chief Retail & Government Business and Priya Deshmukh as Head Health Product Operations & Services
items.quote: We have strengthened our leadership team with the addition of Mr. Anand Singhi -- Chief Retail and Government Business and Priya Deshmukh – Head, Health Product – Operations & Services.

items.statement: Solvency ratio 2.62x at March 31, 2024 vs 2.57x Dec 31, 2023 and 2.5x March 31, 2023; well above 1.5x regulatory minimum
items.quote: The Solvency Ratio was 2.62x at March 31, 2024, as against ₹ 2.57x at December 31, 2023, and continues to be higher than the minimum regulatory requirement of 1.5x.
Return On Average Equity (ROAE) was 17.2% in FY2024 compared to 17.7% in FY2023. Return On Average Equity (ROAE) was 17.8% in Q4 FY2024 compared to 17.2% in Q4 FY2023.

items.statement: Motor claims serviced via Preferred Partner Network: 70% in Q4 FY2024 vs 54% Q4 FY2023
items.quote: In Q4 FY2024, we were able to service 70% of our Agency and Direct claims through our Preferred Partner Network (PPN), up from 54% in Q4 FY2023.

items.statement: Private car sales expected mid-single digit growth FY2025; Two-wheeler 8-10%; CV double-digit growth
items.quote: For the next year, we expect mid-single digit growth in private car sales, while the Two-wheeler segment is expected to deliver 8% to 10% growth. CV sales are expected to grow in double digits in line with the previous year on account of demand from infra sector.

items.statement: Commercial segment grew 14.7% FY2024 vs industry 10%; gained market share in Fire, Marine Cargo, Engineering, Liability; #1 in Marine Cargo & Liability, #2 in Fire & Engineering
items.quote: For FY2024, we grew at 14.7%, which was higher than the industry growth of 10.0%. Further, during the year, we accreted market share across segments such as Fire, Marine Cargo, Engineering and Liability . As we speak, we are at an industry -leading position in Marine Cargo and Liability line s of business, while being the 2nd largest in Fire and Engineering lines of business.

items.statement: Crop insurance contribution 4-5% of revenues; approach opportunistic, dependent on reinsurance terms and pricing
items.quote: in general the crop contribution to the overall revenues for us has been a mid-single digit number in that range of 4% to 5%.

items.statement: Mass health schemes shifting to trust model; company participates only when pricing appropriate for risk assumed
items.quote: some of the states obviously in line with what you said have moved into the trust model. So, therefore to that extent, it may not necessarily be available within the space of insurance. Having said that, we do look at developments in the space wherever we believe the pricing is appropriate for the risk that we are assuming then obviously we will be open to looking at writing this segment.

items.statement: EOM regulation bringing discipline; ~half market within 30% threshold at 9M; rest working to comply
items.quote: roughly about half of the market slightly in excess of half of the market are within the threshold. And I'm sure the rest of the companies possibly are working out ways and means to bring them within the threshold as the regulator has laid out.

items.statement: Continued significant investments in technology modernization post cloud transition; Project Orion transformation underway
items.quote: After transitioning to cloud, we have continued to make significant investments on modernization of our technology platform s. Along with this, our core business and technology transformation project, “Project Orion” is also underway.

items.statement: Completed capital raise of Rs.15 billion via QIP in early April 2024 for margin monies and MTF book growth
items.quote: In this spirit, we recently completed a capital raise of Rs.15 billion which will be primarily used for margin monies with stock exchange and t he growth of our MTF book

items.statement: Gross client acquisition of 2.9 million in Q4 FY24, total client base reached 22.2 million
items.quote: We onboarded about 2.9 million clients within a quarter, stacking up the total client base of 22.2 million clients.

items.statement: Average daily orders grew 86% from Q1 to Q4 FY24, peak orders per day exceeded 10 million
items.quote: I am delighted to share that our average daily order have grown 86% between Q1 and Q4 of FY'24, in that process, achieving the peak orders per day of more than 10 million.

items.statement: Average daily orders grew 32.3% sequentially to 7.73 million in Q4 FY24
items.quote: average daily orders growing by 32.3% sequentially to 7.73 million

items.statement: ADTO grew 23% quarter-on-quarter to nearly Rs.44 trillion in Q4 FY24
items.quote: The ADTO on our platform continued its uptrend, growing by 23% quarter-on-quarter to nearly Rs.44 trillion.

items.statement: Consolidated EBDAT margin expanded to 44.8% in Q4 FY24 from 44% in Q3 FY24, within guided range
items.quote: Our consolidated EBDAT margin expanded to 44.8% for the quarter versus 44% in Q3 of FY'24. This margin remains within our guided range.

items.statement: Full-year margins expected to remain within guided range despite elevated Q1 costs from IPL and increments
items.quote: as we go through the entire year, the margins would be in the range of the guided range and that's where we always advise our analysts and investors to look at our business from a yearly basis and not on a quarter-on-quarter basis.

items.statement: IPL associate sponsorship for 5 years starting 2024, annual committed cost Rs.82.5 crores, Q1 FY25 spend ~Rs.120 crores for remainder of season
items.quote: In the ongoing quarter, we intend to spend about Rs.1.2 billion towards the remainder of the annual sponsorship cost and digital and electronic media advert throughout the ongoing IPL season.

items.statement: Total IPL sponsorship and advert spend for FY25 estimated at Rs.143 crores, Rs.23 crores booked in Q4 FY24
items.quote: the cost of this entire IPL sponsorship and related advert spends is Rs.143 crores as we see it today, of which Rs.23 crores has been accounted for in Q4 and about Rs.120 crores will be accounted for in the current quarter.

items.statement: Board decided to defer dividend payout for next few quarters to conserve resources and support growth
items.quote: Consequently, the Board has decided to defer the dividend payout for the next few quarters to conserve resources, optimize our balance sheet and support our growth trajectory.

items.statement: F&O contributes 85% of gross broking revenue in Q4 FY24, cash 11%, commodity 4%
items.quote: Within this F&O continues to drive the gross broking revenue contributing 85% in Q4 of FY'24, while the share of cash and commodity segments remain stable at 11% and 4% respectively.

items.statement: Client funding book (MTF) grew 9.1% sequentially to average Rs.20.3 billion in Q4 FY24, period-end book at Rs.17.7 billion
items.quote: Higher activity in this segment is an important lever for the growth of our client funding book, which grew by 9.1% sequentially to average at Rs.20.3 billion for the quarter.

items.statement: Finance cost increased 56% quarter-on-quarter to Rs.556 million due to higher borrowings for client funding and margin obligations
items.quote: Finance cost was higher by about 56% quarter-on-quarter to Rs.556 million in Q4 of FY'24 due to a combination of higher average borrowings and higher cost of funds for the period.

items.statement: Employee benefit expenses rose 12% sequentially to Rs.1.59 billion due to headcount additions in Wealth Management, AMC, data analytics, technology and product
items.quote: Employee benefit expenses including cost of granting ESOPs, was at about Rs.1.59 billion for the quarter, sequentially higher by 12% due to additional headcount primarily in the Wealth Management business, ramp up of our asset management business, data analytics, technology and product functions.

items.statement: Registered nearly 1.4 million unique SIPs in Q4 FY24, reinforcing position as second largest in incremental registered SIPs
items.quote: Last quarter alone, we registered nearly 1.4 million unique SIP, showcasing our commitment to guiding clients on their long-term investing journey and enhancing engagement on our platform.

items.statement: Credit and fixed income product integration in beta testing, expect to scale over next few quarters
items.quote: Efforts continued during the quarter to seamlessly integrate credit and fixed income product into our platform, which is currently undergoing beta testing with select clients.

items.statement: AMC core leadership team onboarded, awaiting final regulatory approval for launch
items.quote: On the AMC front, we have onboarded the core leadership team who have been working to get the final approval from the regulator for the swift launch.

items.statement: Launched Wealth Management business led by Srikanth Subramanian targeting UHNI/HNI with tech-led model
items.quote: With respect to our Wealth Management foray, I am happy to introduce to you the team led by Srikanth Subramanian as the co-founders of our Wealth Management business.

items.statement: Meenal Maheshwari Shah onboarded as Group General Counsel with 14+ years experience
items.quote: During the quarter, we further solidified our management bandwidth with the onboarding of Meenal Maheshwari Shah as our Group General Counsel.

items.statement: No new regulatory concerns on F&O; existing focus on preventing misleading profit/loss statements
items.quote: Currently, if you see there is nothing concrete, whatever like discussion we are having with regulator that has been implemented and that is something like does not really concern us because their mostly focus is on not to lure a customer, not to kind of show wrong loss and profit statements and all that.

items.statement: Cohort analysis shows 54% of FY21 acquired clients became active over 4 years, similar trends for subsequent cohorts
items.quote: for FY'21 the cohort of customers that were acquired, close to 54 customers, 54% of them became active over the next four years.

items.statement: Overwhelming majority of F&O clients eventually build long-term equity portfolios, driving client longevity
items.quote: even i n respect of clients who commenced their journey as a trader, an overwhelming majority of them eventually build long-term equity portfolio, thus realizing the virtues of investing in equity as an asset class

items.statement: QIP funds deployed as working capital for exchange margins and MTF book growth, not for debt retirement
items.quote: this QIP was not to retire debt, it's a growth capital. We can see a huge growth and we would like to deploy this capital for the growth of the business be it margin trading book or increasing orders and all that.

items.statement: ROE expected to decline post fund raise before gradually recovering with growth benefits by end of FY25
items.quote: The ROE post the fund raise will also see a decline before gradually going back with growth benefits of deployment coming in towards the end of the financial year.

items.statement: Working capital requirements increased considerably due to daily expiries and growing volumes
items.quote: With every trading day as an expiry day for indices across NSE and BSE, and growing volumes, the working capital requirement for broking businesses of our scale and size have increased considerably over the last few quarters.

items.statement: Depreciation and amortization increased 27% to Rs.167 million due to technology asset augmentation at data center and disaster recovery site
items.quote: Depreciation and amortization costs increased by 27% to Rs.167 million in Q4 of FY'24 on account of augmentation of technology assets at a data center and disaster recovery site, required to manage the growing client base and order volumes.

items.statement: No specific numerical guidance given for future daily order growth; management avoids forward-looking numbers
items.quote: Now, to give a number would be like getting into forward-looking statements.

items.statement: FY25 OPM guided at 43-45% including 1.5-2% drag from new businesses
items.quote: So, what we envisage is that we will be in that range of about 45%, 47% for the next year, but there will be an impact of about 1.5% on the new businesses that we are building across AMC and wealth. So, you can take the average margin profile to be in the range of about 43% to 45% for the next year.

items.statement: MTF book target of Rs.3,000 crores by end of FY26 seen as reasonable
items.quote: Yes, it is a reasonable assumption. So, like already, as I said that by Feb around Rs.2,100, Rs.2,200 crores of MTF. So, to get to that Rs.3,000 crores is like possible, it is not a difficult target, aspirational target will be higher than that.

items.statement: New client acquisition market share aspiration of 35% in digital broking
items.quote: So, our aspirations on this client addition, as we always say, being a digital player, we would aim to get a market share of around , in new acquisition, to the tune of around 35%.

items.statement: IPL sponsorship for 5 years to drive brand recall in Tier-3+ markets
items.quote: On IPL, it is not about recovering cost, it is about, as I said, that we have an aspiration to get a market share of new acquisition to 35%. And as I said in digital business lead indicators are that what a kind of recall people have for your brand.

items.statement: AP business margin at 62% structural but will moderate as new sub-brokers onboarded
items.quote: Going forward as we kind of start onboarding new sub-brokers and we start incurring some of those costs, plus as we unlock new regions, in particular, rest of India where the existing presence or the existing contribution to the revenue is not that strong, I think some of these costs would also come into play and therefore the margin that you're referring to would kind of sober down a bit.

items.statement: ESOP cost budgeted at Rs.100 crores for FY25 (Rs.50-52 cr carry forward + Rs.50 cr new grants)
items.quote: So, for the next financial year, our budget for the ESOP cost is about Rs.100 crores, of which about Rs.50, Rs.52 crores is the carry forward cost of the ESOPs that have been granted over the last two or three years and about Rs.50 crores will be the cost which will be incurred towards the new grants that we are going to do in this year.

items.statement: MTF book declined to Rs.1,770 crores in Q4 FY24 due to capital constraints; restrictions lifted post-QIP
items.quote: So, MTF book was also rising proportionate to our customer base and volumes that we did in terms of number of orders. But by Feb, we realize that it is going to a point where we need more capital. That is where we had put restrictions on customer availing this margin trailing.

items.statement: Bank guarantee deployment at Rs.2,800 crores fully own-funded since Sep 2023
items.quote: Our current bank guarantee deployment across the clearing corporations is about Rs.2,800 crores. And apart from that, we also avail intraday facilities for the time differences for the settlement with the exchanges.

items.statement: Retail F&O market share stable at 44-45%; no price pressure or fatigue seen
items.quote: You see, the market share of retail almost it has remained constant, that does not fluctuate in a big way, would be in the region of 44% to 45%.

items.statement: Lending product in beta testing; aggressive build-out planned over next 2-3 years
items.quote: Lending is largely the biggest area in Financial Services in India, and we also have very high aspirations there. At the moment we are in beta testing phase of the lending product and the experience for our customers. And as soon as we are out of it, we will start to aggressively build this vertical in the next two to three years.

items.statement: Deposit offering (corporate bonds, FDs) launching this quarter or early next quarter with bank/NBFC tie-ups
items.quote: In terms of deposits also, I think most likely this quarter or early next quarter we should be out with our deposit offering, where we will have tied up with a few banks and NBFCs to offer their corporate bonds and FDs.

items.statement: Wealth Management targeting UHNI ($5M+) and affluent/emerging HNI segments with tech-enabled omnichannel model
items.quote: We do have aspirations to create two large verticals. One is to cater to the ultra-high net worth or in other words $5 million plus which is something that the team has almost two decades of experience in terms of catering to. We think that there are huge opportunities available there in terms of cost overheads that can be brought down using technology and that is one of the reasons why we are sup

items.statement: Corporate structure changes still under regulatory engagement; no update yet
items.quote: No, we are still engaging with the regulator in terms of making them understand the entire structure. So, no update as of now.

items.statement: AMC approval process progressing in line with industry timelines; no regulatory TAT
items.quote: On the AMC front, we are currently undergoing the process of getting the approval. While there is no regulatory TAT on when will get the approval, I can just say you that we are progressing well on that front.

items.statement: No difficulty in availing bank guarantees; no regulatory backlash on advertising spend
items.quote: No, we did not face any kind of difficulty in availing bank guarantees.

items.statement: FY24 acquired 8.8M customers contributed Rs.615 cr revenue (partial year); cohort modeling shows 1.5-2% error rate
items.quote: Now coming to FY'24, the way you are calculating, we acquired 8.8 million, but the revenue of these customers did not come for all 12 months. So, if you see our most of the acquisition has happened in December, Jan and Feb. So, they haven't contributed for a total of 12 months.

items.statement: FY21 cohort: 54% of 2.4M acquired customers became active over 4 years
items.quote: So, when we now revisit this data in the following year, I am sure we will see a larger number there and similar is the behavior of the subsequent cohort of customers that we acquired. So, I hope that address es your question, Arvind

items.statement: Larger players entering market seen as expanding total addressable market, not threat
items.quote: So, we always feel that a new player coming in with a big budget is going to expand this market and that is going to help us increase our market share.

items.statement: No price pressure on F&O products; cash segment currently free but could be monetized
items.quote: No, currently we are not seeing any kind of price pressure or any fatigue in terms of the product that we are offering. Retail is just like playing on the direction of the market. they buy, call or sell the thing, buy, put, beyond that their activity is limited. So, what we do is that we try to design certain kind of like product journeys where they're able to understand this better. When it comes

items.statement: Wealth Management leadership team onboarded ~1-1.5 months ago; deep domain + tech integration planned
items.quote: I think the teams have just come on board about a month, month and a half back. We do have aspirations to create two large verticals. One is to cater to the ultra-high net worth or in other words $5 million plus which is something that the team has almost two decades of experience in terms of catering to.

items.statement: Realized equity gain Rs.5.5B and unrealized gain Rs.18B (Rs.24B gain on Rs.66B portfolio) for FY21 cohort over 4 years
items.quote: The realized equity gain is that part of the gain that was bought and sold in the course of the four years. The unrealized gain is those that are getting held, continue to be held as on FY'24 and that value of the portfolio is actually worth Rs.66 billion and a gain of Rs.24 billion of that Rs.66 billion, the Rs.66 billion includes the gain of Rs.24 billion.

items.statement: Customer acquisition cost payback period 6-7 months; lifetime value modeled with 1.5-2% error
items.quote: And we have been perfect modeling that to the tune of like error of 1.5%, 2%. So, the clients that we have acquired clearly show that they are profitable, and they will fall within that bracket of breakeven of six to seven months.

items.statement: QIP raised for growth capital, not for bank guarantee replacement
items.quote: As we said that this QIP was raised for growth, it was not for the replacement of any instrument, but Vineet would be the right person to take this question.

items.statement: QIP completed to capitalize for MTF book growth; MTF restrictions now lifted
items.quote: So, that we are well capitalized to ride this trend kind of like growth in this MTF book. So, we took a pause. Now, we have restored back to normal. You will see a growth in MTF going forward.

items.statement: No M&A discussed; organic build-out of Wealth, AMC, lending, deposits
items.quote: We see huge kind of synergy and this all business that we are building, complements to what we are doing until now. So, when we are talking about acquiring customers as we look at the prospect, if we look at that our services should be available across all segments, be it mass affluent, HNI, UHNI and all that.
